educationalGoal: Students will learn about various Asian cultures in English. It is a reading course where students can expect to 1) learn new vocabulary 2) be able to understand and summarize short reading passages 3) think critically about a text 4) express their own opinions about a text
advice: Students will learn about various Asian cultures through short reading materials. The course is based on the textbook Asian Issues 1. The themes of the course include Asian cultures, cities, food, and entertainment. Students will have 10 homework assignments and there will be 2 speaking tests (week 7 and week 14). The general layout of a class includes reading and understanding a short text, being able to think critically about it, and then expressing an opinion about the text. Students who take the course can expect to develop their reading skills and also practice expressing their opinion about a particular topic.
books: Asian Issues 1: Practice in Critical Thinking [Abax]
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic grammar and vocabulary. An interest in Asian culture.

activityGoals.body: Acquire new vocabulary related to Asian culture.
Read and understand short texts written in English.
Critical thinking about issues relating to Asian cultures.
Expressing opinions about topics relating to Asian cultures.
